note_assistant.label: Note Assistant
note_assistant.title: Note Assistant
note_assistant.description: Select an AI agent to maintain and optimize your notes. The agent will be able to read, organize, and improve note content.
note_assistant.has_notebook_tool_desc: This agent can read and modify notes directly. Click the AI optimize button in the note editor to use it.
note_assistant.no_notebook_tool_desc: This agent does not have the Notebook tool. Please enable it in Agent Manager for full note management capabilities.
note_assistant.step1: 1. Select an agent above (make sure it has the Notebook tool enabled)
note_assistant.step2: 2. Open a note in the Notebook panel
note_assistant.step3: 3. Click the ✨ AI Optimize button in the editor toolbar to auto-optimize the note

plugin_assistant.label: Plugin Assistant
plugin_assistant.title: Plugin Assistant
plugin_assistant.description: Bind an AI agent as your plugin assistant. The agent can help you generate, develop, and test plugins through conversation in the Plugin panel.
plugin_assistant.has_plugin_manager_desc: This agent can manage plugins. Go to the Plugin panel to start a conversation.
plugin_assistant.no_plugin_manager_desc: Please enable the "plugin_manager" tool for this agent in the Agent configuration.
plugin_assistant.step1: 1. Select or create an agent above, make sure the "plugin_manager" tool is enabled.
plugin_assistant.step2: 2. Go to the Plugin panel in the left sidebar.
plugin_assistant.step3: 3. Chat with the agent: describe what plugin you need, and it will generate, test, and save the plugin for you.
plugin_assistant.step4: 4. Saved plugins will appear as available tools in your other agents.

plugin_page.title: Plugins
plugin_page.no_plugins: No plugins yet. Chat with the assistant to create one!
plugin_page.no_agent_bound_desc: Please bind an agent first, or go to AI Assistant → Plugin Assistant tab. The agent needs the "plugin_manager" tool enabled to manage plugins.
plugin_page.empty_hint: Tell the assistant what plugin you need. For example: "I need a plugin that can query IP geolocation"
plugin_page.delete_plugin_message: Are you sure you want to delete plugin "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
plugin_page.refine_prompt: Please help me refine the plugin "{{name}}" (id: {{id}}). Follow these steps: 1) Use the plugin_manager 'get' action to read the plugin's full code and configuration; 2) Analyze issues in the code (error handling, edge cases, performance, etc.); 3) Use the 'refine' action to improve the plugin; 4) Use the 'test' action to verify the improved tool works correctly. Make sure to actually call the tools at each step — do not answer from memory.
plugin_page.group_has_plugins_message: Group "{{name}}" has {{count}} plugin(s). Please remove or reassign all plugins before deleting this group.
plugin_page.log_summary_footer: Based on the usage log data above, focus on fixing failures and optimizing performance.

copilot.label: Copilot
copilot.title: Terminal Copilot
copilot.description: Bind an AI agent as your terminal copilot. Click the AI button in the terminal toolbar to open a standalone window for command suggestions, error analysis, and operation guidance.
copilot.has_terminal_tool_desc: This agent can execute terminal commands. Click the AI button in the terminal toolbar to use it.
copilot.no_terminal_tool_desc: This agent does not have a terminal tool. Please enable the Terminal or Terminal Session tool in Agent Manager.
copilot.step1: 1. Select or create an agent above (make sure the Terminal tool is enabled)
copilot.step2: 2. Click the 🤖 AI button in the terminal toolbar to open the copilot window
copilot.step3: 3. Ask AI questions like "how to check port usage" or "explain this command"
copilot.no_agent_bound_desc: Go to AI Assistant → Terminal Copilot tab to bind an agent first. The agent needs a terminal tool enabled.
copilot.agent_missing: The bound Terminal Copilot no longer exists
copilot.agent_missing_desc: The previously bound agent may have been deleted or renamed. Go to AI Assistant → Terminal Copilot tab and select an agent again.
copilot.no_sessions: No conversations yet. Click + at the top right to create one
copilot.empty_hint: Ask the AI copilot a question, like "how to check port usage" or "explain this command"
copilot.rd_empty_hint: Install a remote terminal, or ask the AI assistant — e.g. "how to check port usage" or "explain this command"
copilot.rd_input_placeholder: Install a remote terminal, or ask the AI assistant...

copilot.rd_install_confirm_desc: Let the AI assistant install and configure it? This will modify the remote server (non-interactive installation of TigerVNC and a desktop environment).

copilot.rd_decline_message: OK, skip installation. Tell me when you want VNC installed on the remote server.
copilot.srv_empty_hint: Ask the AI assistant to probe the deploy environment, e.g. "check the server's deploy environment", or ask anything
copilot.srv_input_placeholder: Ask the AI assistant to probe/install the deploy environment, or ask anything...

copilot.srv_install_confirm_desc: Let the AI assistant install and configure the deploy environment (nginx + systemd auto-start + firewall rules for 80/443)? This will modify the remote server.
copilot.srv_already_ready: Deploy environment is ready (nginx running). You can deploy the site now.

copilot.srv_decline_message: OK, skip installation. Tell me when you want the deploy environment prepared.
